title: Canonical component-lift coefficient and section data
statement: For a commutative condensed ring Lambda [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring], an affine scheme T [def-pc-scheme], a profinite S, and a specified homeomorphism e:pi_0(T) ≃ S [lem-pe-spectral-components-profinite], define the relative-test functor by transporting componentTests along e inverse. ComponentLiftCoefficient records its universal projections, its exact braided inverse image with its constructed adjunction and point factorization, and the resulting specified coefficient isomorphism. Define the module functor by mapMod followed by restriction along the inverse coefficient isomorphism, and derive it termwise. Define the section map by the module-adjunction unit evaluated at the terminal test followed by terminal pullback restriction; define the derived Hom evaluation by singleFunctor.preimage evaluated at the specified coefficient one. ComponentLiftLisseFacts, ComponentLiftHomIdentity, ComponentLiftMonoidal, ComponentLiftSectionIdentity, IsComponentLiftMap, ComponentLiftInducedComparison, ComponentLiftEquivalence, ComponentLiftSectionComposition and ComponentLiftSectionNaturality are precisely the formulas retained verbatim from the parent module. No new mathematical notion replaces any of these formulas.
